item.title: SRTC is top ASN nursing program among state’s technical colleges
item.description: The Georgia Board of Nursing recently reported that from 2022 through 2025, 383 graduates earned an Associate of Science in Nursing (ASN) degree from Southern Regional Technical College, meeting the educational requirements to sit for the NCLEX-RN.

item.title: Unsealed FBI warrant reveals a search for fraud in 2020 presidential election
item.description: The FBI’s investigation of the 2020 presidential election in Fulton County is focused on allegations of double-counted ballots, “pristine” absentee ballots and missing digital ballot images, according to a search warrant affidavit unsealed Tuesday.
